title: bin/cairn.py dispatches superclaude to cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py and runs interactive verbs with the console inherited
intention: cairn superclaude runs cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py through bin/cairn.py with the dispatcher's console inherited, so no bash, wsl or sudo is in its process tree.
why: Measured 2026-11-22 on akiendell: cairn superclaude exited 127 silently because the dispatcher ran a bash launcher and where.exe lists WSL's bash.exe first. superclaude.py (1941e93b25a3) exists; nothing dispatches to it, and _run starts every verb with CREATE_NO_WINDOW, which gives an interactive claude a hidden console instead of this one.
traces_to: Outline 10.3.2.1 and 5.4.3.8 (superclaude is Python; Windows needs no bash); Law 1 (the settled launcher is dispatched, not re-derived); Law 3 (the proof measures the spawn kwargs).
how: bin/cairn.py: _wire_link takes an optional verb name; _wire_instances links cc/superclaude.py as the verb superclaude in instance 0's bin (a stale link at the bash is repointed); _wiring_gap reports that stale link; _run spawns a verb named in INTERACTIVE_VERBS = {'superclaude'} with no creationflags and no std handle keywords, so claude owns this console, and every other verb keeps windowless_kwargs. The 126 refusal of a shell script on a box that runs none stays.

clauses.claim: _wire_instances over scratch roots links cc/superclaude.py as <instance root>/superclaude/0/bin/superclaude, repoints a link at the bash, and _wiring_gap reports a stale link
_run on the superclaude verb calls subprocess.call with [sys.executable, <the file>] and no creationflags, stdin, stdout or stderr keyword, while another verb still carries creationflags
a script with a shell shebang on a box with no shell on PATH returns 126, naming the script

decisions.text: D1: _wire_link takes a verb name, _wire_instances and _wiring_gap use it for superclaude.py, and _run spawns INTERACTIVE_VERBS with the console inherited.
D2: the proof, one tooth per clause, red first, with a scratch CLASS_ROOT and INSTANCE_ROOT and subprocess.call replaced to record kwargs.

measured.saw: bin/cairn.py _run starts every verb with windowless_kwargs(given=()), i.e. CREATE_NO_WINDOW; _wire_instances links cc/superclaude (the bash) as the verb

akiendell, `cairn superclaude -p "reply with the single word ok"` from cmd.exe, parent chain sampled every 400 ms with Get-CimInstance Win32_Process: cmd -> bin/cairn.py -> ~/.cairn/devices/superclaude/0/bin/superclaude (python, the symlink to cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py) -> floor.py verify, floor.py apply (pip install --editable) -> superclaude.py inner -> claude.exe, which answered ok, exit 0. No bash.exe, wsl.exe or sudo anywhere between the shim and claude.exe. The bash.exe processes seen are children of claude.exe itself (its own hooks: memory_sync, slate), not of the launcher. `cairn superclaude --dry-run` printed the exec line. The instance-bin link now targets cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py.
measured.how: PowerShell Win32_Process watcher over the descendants of the launching cmd.exe; log in the session scratchpad treewatch.log. Run from a non-elevated PowerShell/Windows Terminal, not a fresh elevated one: a peer cannot open an elevated shell.
